description: DATA-OUT entry: finds the average spectrum of a section of an analysis file and writes it as a TEXTFILE of tab-separated frequency/amplitude pairs (one line per analysis channel - 513 lines from a 1024-point analysis, verified). -n normalises the amplitude column to peak at 1.0 (verified: max amp exactly 1.000000). Mode 1 of three: mode 2 averages several analysis files (variadic multi-input), mode 3 dumps the changing spectrum as a SET of numbered textfiles (verified multi-output naming '<stem>_1.txt, _2.txt, ...') - both dropped. BANNER DIVERGENCE: starttime 0 is REFUSED - the enforced minimum is one frametime ('0' refused verbatim: 'Parameter[1] Value (0.000000) out of range (0.002902 to 2.023038)'); endtime's ceiling is just past the analysed duration ('(0.005805 to 2.025941)'). Deterministic (byte-identical reruns).
musical_use: The spectrum probe of the toolkit: extract a sound's average spectral fingerprint as plain text - inspect it, plot it, or feed it back into synthesis and filtering. The banner's own suggestion: with -n it displays the formant contour of a source. Downstream uses: pick the strongest frequencies from the list to build a hilite greq filtfile or filter userbank tuned to another sound's resonances (a poor-man's cross-synthesis via data); track how a sound's centre of mass sits before choosing spectral-frequency treatments. Windowed sections (starttime/endtime) let you fingerprint just an attack or just the steady state. Pure data output - nothing to audition; read the file.

starttime.description: Start of the averaged section. CDP-enforced from ONE FRAMETIME (not 0 - banner divergence, refusal verbatim '(0.002902 to 2.023038)') to just short of the analysed duration; input-dependent bounds. Use e.g. 0.01 for 'the start'.

endtime.description: End of the averaged section; must exceed starttime. CDP-enforced up to the sfprops duration ('99' refused verbatim quoting '(0.005805 to 2.025941)').

normalise.description: Normalise the output data to peak at 1.0 (banner: useful to display the formant contour of the source). Verified: amplitude column max exactly 1.000000.

examples.expected_use: 513 'frq amp' lines; strongest lines = the source's formant/resonance centres.
Average spectrum of just the onset - compare against the steady state.

known_issues: DATA-TO-DATA OUTPUT (.txt): no audio verification or audition; the duration model is a placeholder and the findings duration row is null.
starttime 0 is refused (minimum = one analysis frametime, input-dependent) - the banner's 'Start time of section' does not mention this.

Mode 2 (average of SEVERAL analysis files, variadic inputs) and mode 3 (set of numbered textfiles per groupcnt windows - verified writes '<stem>_1.txt' etc., no file at the declared name) are not curated; mode 3 is a standing-rule multi-output drop.
Output format: tab-separated 'frequency<TAB>amplitude', one line per channel, frequencies ascending - directly consumable by scripts and by hand-built filter banks.
